title: Workflow why document
description:
Guiding question: Why does this workflow exist and why does it have this shape?

It records why, and never repeats what the definition already states, such as types, defaults and the order of steps.

purpose.description: One sentence stating what it is meant to achieve.

problem.description: What goes wrong without it and why that matters: the risk and its consequence.

value.description: The benefit while it works as intended.

placement.description: Why it is shared in the governance repository and not local to each repository, or why it is local.

flow.description: Why the jobs run in this order or in parallel.

permissions.description: Why each permission is granted, by permission name.

inputs.description: Why each input exists and why its default is what it is.

outputs.description: What each output is used for.

callers.description: What a calling workflow supplies and what it keeps for itself.
